description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended futibatinib for the treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic cholangiocarcinoma harbouring an FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement whose disease has progressed after at least one prior line of systemic therapy. Futibatinib is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
